subject: Business Models
title: Cross-Subsidization
description: A fast breakdown of Cross-Subsidization for builders.

hook.text: Banks offer free checking accounts. The real revenue comes from overdraft fees: $30 billion/year.

buildup.text: Cross-subsidization makes one product free (or cheap) and profits from a related paid product.

discovery.text: Google gives away Android free. Revenue comes from Search and Play Store fees on every Android phone.

twist.text: The subsidized product builds dependency. Once you're on Android, Google's ads follow you everywhere.

climax.text: Cross-subsidies hide the true cost. The 'free' thing is always paid for somewhere else.

punchline.text: Free checking, $35 overdraft fees. The subsidy always hides a tax.

quiz.question: How does Google profit from giving away Android?
options: Search ads and Play Store fees
